title: Post-reset observation with masked history (Expert)
description: One 5 Hz observation assembled immediately after a participant reset at Expert difficulty. reset_generation has advanced to 2, masks.history_valid is 0 and every history feature (51-56) is masked to zero ('Preserve feature timestamps and reset history to zero/masked defaults'); post_reset_defaults_applied lists the reverted fields. Ego shows the post-reset state: low speed, grounded, respawn immunity active, and valid-progress flag 0 because the reset itself earns no progress. Neighbor traffic is still drawn from the delayed snapshot (one car 14 m ahead), because masking applies to own history, not to current race state. traffic_age_ticks is the Expert default 7 (sampled_tick 800, traffic_snapshot_tick 793). The exact masked default values are authored placeholders (zero), not specified values; see unknowns. Status 'provisional'.

expectations.statement: Record difficulty, style and participant_id match the fixture context.
Exactly one difficulty one-hot is set and it is Expert (index 59).
Classic-only style leaves both style one-hot inputs at 0/0.
One neighbor slot is present (index 32) and the rest are absent and zeroed; masks.neighbor_slots agrees.
Expert difficulty uses the 7-tick delayed traffic snapshot.
post_reset_defaults_applied is true, so history_valid is 0, reset_generation is at least 1, and every history feature is masked to zero.
The raw_inputs probes normalize to the recorded values (speed/top-speed, neighbor route gap/70 m).
No safe diagnostic fallback is active; masking is a reset, not a fallback.
Every null that means 'not yet determined' has a matching unknowns entry.
